tags.label: About the graphic design
tags.info: I refreshed the look and feel of these screens myself and modified them to respect the NDA. The original visual design may differ.

text: Personal finance is built around experts, not users: most people understand very little of their own plan. I’d felt it myself planning projects with my financial advisor, so I set out to *make personal finance accessible* through simple, highly visual interfaces.

One way I did this was the project timeline: people see what they need to save and by when, move a goal to another year, split it into smaller steps and compare scenarios, with AI suggesting a plan A and a backup plan B.
